findings.title: [PORT] 20 evidence/ files committed with mixed line endings
findings.impact: Mixed EOL in byte-exact, append-only evidence files. Nothing in CI consumes these as text, so the practical impact is low.
findings.recommendation: Leave evidence bytes untouched (MANIFEST.sha256 pins them); adjust the deterministic check to skip `-text` paths instead of flagging them.
findings.note: False-positive-by-design: evidence is append-only and hash-pinned.

findings.title: [SUPPLY] 2 container images without a digest pin
findings.impact: The two images are built in place from a digest-pinned node base; the local `certified` tag has no upstream digest to pin.
findings.recommendation: Keep the documented out-of-band released-digest record (LAUNCH_ATTESTED_IMAGES) and the docs/runbooks/DEPLOY.md refresh step.
findings.note: False-positive: locally built images, not registry pulls.

report: Ran tools/deterministic_checks.py on the lab checkout at 38b34a9 (gitleaks 8.30.1 installed): 2 machine findings (P2 x1, P3 x1). The repository's own scripts/repo-secret-scan.sh also reported 'no leaks found' (46.02 MB scanned at 38b34a9). The PORT P2 is a false-positive-by-design: the 20 files are append-only evidence artifacts marked `-text` in .gitattributes to stay byte-exact against evidence/MANIFEST.sha256 (only one file has a true index CRLF). The SUPPLY P3 flags the locally built `snowride-web:certified` / `snowride-realtime:certified` tags, which are build outputs, not pulled images.
